responsibility: Declares the HIR visitor that checks declaration-time correctness of pub(crate), pub(self), pub(super), and pub(in path) restrictions. Its interface defines the module-stack-based validation routine and the vis-item traversal hooks used to ensure restricted visibilities only name ancestor modules of the item being declared, separating this concern from visibility resolution and privacy use reporting.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface half of the pub-restricted visitor pair: unlike rust-pub-restricted-visitor.cc, it declares the visitor API, the restriction-validation entry point, and the module-stack state without implementing the ancestry walk or diagnostics.
